docs.title: Commands
docs.text:
• mkdocs new [dir-name] - Create a new project.
  • mkdocs serve - Start the live-reloading docs server.
  • mkdocs build - Build the documentation site.
  • mkdocs -h - Print help message and exit.

docs.title: Project layout
docs.text:
mkdocs.yml    # The configuration file.
docs/
    index.md  # The documentation homepage.
    ...       # Other markdown pages, images and other files.

The Procrastination Bug

If you spend more than 20 minutes choosing layout settings instead of typing text, you are officially in an execution loop.

System Crash

Be careful with the !!! syntax. If you don't indent the body text below it with exactly 4 spaces, the compiler will fail to style the container correctly.

Velocity Over Perfection

Shipping a messy v0.1 website onto a free GitHub subdomain beats having an idealized setup sitting solely in your brain every single time.

Click to view the structural layout code

Here is some extra technical detail or background context that would otherwise clutter your primary layout flow.

docs.title: The Problem
docs.text: Spending weeks choosing layouts instead of writing raw text.

docs.title: The Fix
docs.text: Accept a messy v0.1 over a perfect imaginary v1.0.
